now.title: Deadpool 2
now.text: Black Tom rides in the prison convoy with Russell and Deadpool, and Cable kills him when he attacks it.
cases: FX-022 The Ice Box Convoy Attack (Deadpool 2)

proposed.text: Black Tom rides in the prison convoy with Russell, and Cable shoots him dead in his cell when he attacks it.

changes.evidence: Deadpool is not aboard the convoy: Wade is ejected from the Ice Box during Cable's attack and later leads X-Force's parachute assault on the transfer convoy. Black Tom is placed in a containment cell on the convoy truck, and Cable shoots him in his cell during the fight (Deadpool 2).

now.title: Deadpool
now.text: Weasel runs Sister Margaret's bar and helps Deadpool find Ajax.

proposed.text: Weasel runs Sister Margaret's bar, and after talking with him, the scarred Wade decides to hunt Ajax as Deadpool.

changes.evidence: Weasel does not help find Ajax: after consulting Weasel, Wade decides to hunt Ajax and takes the name Deadpool from Weasel's dead pool; it is the Recruiter who reveals Ajax's whereabouts, and Weasel opts out of the rescue (Deadpool).

now.title: Deadpool 2
now.text: Blind Al is still Wade's roommate as he grieves Vanessa.

proposed.text: Wade visits Blind Al as he grieves Vanessa, and she tries to get him to move on with his life.

changes.evidence: In Deadpool 2 Wade had been living with Vanessa; after her death he visits (breaks into) Blind Al's home, and she unsuccessfully tries to convince him to move on. He is not shown as her roommate in this film.
